outputs.explanation: Spatial transcriptomic cluster image, not a quantitative plot of averaged data.
H&E histology images with manual annotation, not a plot.
H&E image and spatial expression heatmap-style plots showing per-spot mRNA levels across tissue; not a bar/summary plot of averaged data requiring individual point overlay.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; overlaying individual data points would be unreadable and is not expected for this plot type.

Bar chart shows log2 fold change per gene from differential expression analysis (T11b-high vs low), a summary statistic derived from underlying spot-level expression data, but no individual data points (e.g., per-spot expression values) are overlaid on the bars.
